data.subject: CPBI public-record research
data.body:
Hi,

Your fund's most recent 13F (period June 30, 2026) shows positions in CPBI, SFBC, and LSBK.

On September 23, 2026, CPBI disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1979332/000094337426000419/cpbi-20260922.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and discuss a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
